item.title: Android Tablet Touch Screen Educational
item.description: This SKU (YCS-TAB-001) is sourced from audited Chinese factories with AQL 2.5 quality control and DDP shipping to 50+ countries. For importers, e-commerce sellers, and wholesale buyers, Android Tablet Touch Screen Educational (SKU YCS-TAB-001) offers factory-direct quality at $3.09 USD per unit. Sourced from verified Chinese manufacturers with full QC documentation. Sourced from verified Tablets manufacturers with on-site audit. A 3-stage QC pipeline — IQC incoming-material, IPQC in-line at 4 checkpoints, OQC pre-shipment — runs on every batch, with 20-page photo + video inspection reports shared before the balance payment milestone. Compliance documents available on request.
